codeReview.summary: The scaffold-package feature was implemented correctly and completely. All requirements from the feature description were met: Vite 6 + React 19 + TypeScript setup, vite.config.ts with React plugin, ~/ alias, /api proxy to localhost:3002, port 3003, tsconfig.json extending base config, Tailwind v4 via @tailwindcss/postcss, and all entry files (index.html, main.tsx, index.css). The dev:explorer script was added to root package.json. Verification showed pnpm install succeeded, dev server starts on port 3003, and page renders with Tailwind styles applied. Code follows biome.json conventions (tabs, single quotes, no semicolons).

sharedStateObservations.observation: The explorer service was already documented in services.yaml before this feature ran. The worker correctly used 'pnpm dev:explorer' and 'lsof -ti :3003 | xargs kill' for start/stop commands matching the existing service definition.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: services.yaml already had explorer service with port 3003 and correct start/stop commands

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker correctly followed biome.json code style (tabs, single quotes, no semicolons). The main.tsx was fixed to use explicit null check instead of non-null assertion.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Transcript shows fixes applied for CSS quotes and non-null assertion patterns

sharedStateObservations.observation: The architecture.md and AGENTS.md were already well-documented for the explorer package setup, including framework choices (React 19, Vite 6, Tailwind v4), styling approach (CSS-native config, no tailwind.config.ts), and the constraint that explorer must NOT depend on @geo-runtime/shared.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Worker correctly avoided adding @geo-runtime/shared dependency and used Tailwind v4 via @tailwindcss/postcss as documented
